scientific_integrity: Rotational character and nonequivariant wedge count are attributed to prior results; only reflection traces and ensuing full dihedral character and quotient ranks are presented as new. The proof is combinatorial, with separate finite checks. Independent scientific assessment not performed.
scientific_limitations: Rational homology representations and rational orbit-space homology only; p>=2, n>=6p-3. Relies on the published shellability theorem in this exact range. The finite verifier confirms examples but does not prove the general lemma. No claim for integral orbit homology or homotopy equivalence. An unindexed identical reflection result remains a possible literature-overlap risk.
title: Dihedral reflection characters and quotient homology of cycle-power three-cut complexes
